title: Query a WFS 2.0 feature type
prompt: Write a standalone TypeScript ESM program that queries a WFS 2.0 endpoint. The capabilities endpoint is <HONUA_EVAL_BASE_URL>/geoserver/ows and the feature type is "ne:ne_10m_admin_0_countries". Use the contract API from @honua/sdk-js: HonuaClient with { baseUrl: <base URL> }, createDataset from @honua/sdk-js/contract with one source { id: "countries", protocol: "wfs", locator: { url: <base URL>/geoserver/ows, typeName: "ne:ne_10m_admin_0_countries" }, capabilities: PROTOCOL_DEFAULT_CAPABILITIES.wfs } and skipCompatibilityCheck: true. Query with { pagination: { limit: 2 } }. Print exactly one line to stdout: {"count": <result.features.length>, "firstName": <the name attribute of the first feature>}.

context.notes: Golden workflow: WFS GetCapabilities discovery + GetFeature against the DCP-advertised URL.
